requirements.requirement: Serve infra.test authoritatively with node1 as primary and node2/node3 as secondaries.
requirements.summary: Final runtime zone status shows active named services, node1 as primary, node2 and node3 as secondaries, and all serving signed serial 2026090206.

requirements.requirement: DNSSEC-sign infra.test and publish app.infra.test as node1's service address and status.infra.test as TXT "ready".
requirements.summary: Node1 is 10.100.202.10; authoritative responses contain the required A and TXT values, DNSKEY records, and RRSIGs. The required values and signed service persisted through restart.

requirements.requirement: Support authenticated DNS updates from node1.
requirements.summary: An unauthenticated update was refused and remained absent, while TSIG-authenticated updates from node1 succeeded and produced signed records both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Propagate primary changes to both secondaries.
requirements.summary: Both secondaries authoritatively served the updated TXT records with RRSIGs and matching SOA serials, including the post-restart update at serial 2026090206.

requirements.requirement: Configure node4 to resolve infra.test through both secondaries.
requirements.summary: NetworkManager and resolv.conf list both secondary addresses; node4 queried both directly, resolved through the default path, and retained the configuration and functionality after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Keep resolution available while one authoritative server is unavailable.
requirements.summary: Both secondaries were healthy before the test; node2 was then stopped with port 53 closed, node4 continued receiving authoritative answers from node3, and node2 was restored active with the current data and serial.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for all four nodes: each has a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity matching the fixed lifecycle observations, and recovered service, data, resolver, and authoritative topology state.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Package installation, DNS configuration, firewall access, resolver configuration, authenticated test updates, and required reboots all had direct task or evidence roles. The bounded node2 outage was restored, temporary command files were removed, package checks remained healthy, and no failed services or abandoned task files were observed after execution.
